renderer: Direct3D 11 or Direct3D 12 (ray tracing optional); Vulkan also present
binary: MetroExodus.exe (64-bit, Steam build 6544595, Steam DRM wrapper section .bind; code not encrypted on disk)
summary: The original 2019 edition, which runs on a GTX 1660 SUPER (the Enhanced Edition, appid 1449560, does not; see metro-exodus-enhanced.json). Started unattended through Steam, intros skipped with Escape, main menu reached, menus driven by arrow keys and Enter, quit from the main menu with Escape then Enter. Plays in a 1280x720 window after an outside resize. Shares its Saved Games settings folder with the Enhanced Edition.

working.route: Launch: steam://run/412020 (no launch-options prompt when no arguments are passed). Window title '4A Engine', class '_uengine_'.
SendInput scancodes to the foreground window. Escape (0x01) skips each intro film ('PRESS ... TO SKIP'); arrows need the extended flag.

Main menu: Left/Right arrows move between the panel buttons (NEW GAME, CHAPTERS, CONTINUE, LOAD, OPTIONS, DLC); the small screen above names the selected one. Enter opens it. Options list: Up/Down, Enter; Escape goes back.
Quit: on the main menu press Escape -> 'QUIT GAME' dialog -> Enter (OK). The process exits cleanly.

Window: user.cfg 'r_fullscreen off' gives a captioned window the size of the desktop (the game ignores r_res_hor/r_res_vert for the window); then SetWindowPos to a 1280x720 client area works and the picture fills it. The desktop stays 1920x1080.

disproved.route: Absolute mouse positioning (SetCursorPos + click) on the main menu: the game's own pointer did not follow, and a click opened nothing.
user.cfg 'r_api 2' to get Direct3D 11: the game kept the value but still created a Direct3D 12 device (D3D12Core.dll and NvHairWorksDx12 loaded).

states.intro: Several films with letterbox bars; Escape skips each.
states.main_menu: A train cab control panel with labelled buttons; a 'new downloadable content' notice may show top right.
states.difficulty: NEW GAME opens a difficulty list (READER .. RANGER HARDCORE): Enter starts a new game, Escape goes back. Keep Enter away from the main menu until the selection is verified.
states.options_video: RESOLUTION, ASPECT RATIO, QUALITY, VSYNC, GAMMA, MOTION BLUR; resolution shows 1920X1080 even when the window is 1280x720.

hazards.claim: Enter on the main menu acts on whatever button is selected; on first start that is NEW GAME. Escape and Space while skipping intros reached the difficulty screen once.
The game rewrites user.cfg at start and on exit; r_res_hor/r_res_vert were put back to 1920x1080 by a Direct3D 12 windowed run.

config.user_cfg: %USERPROFILE%\Saved Games\Metro Exodus\<steamid>\user.cfg (shared with the Enhanced Edition)
config.window: r_fullscreen off, then resize the window from outside
config.renderer: r_api: 3 = Direct3D 12 observed; the Direct3D 11 value is not yet confirmed
